skill.name: seo-content-writer
skill.description: Creates SEO-focused articles, outlines, titles, meta descriptions, summaries, internal linking ideas, and FAQ sections from keyword and topic briefs.
skill.summary: Writes complete SEO content packages from topic briefs and target keywords.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a false positive caused by a Markdown inline code path on SKILL.md line 25. No executable shell command, prompt injection, network access, secret handling, or data exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed skill instructions.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks delimit a Markdown file path, not Ruby or shell execution. The line only tells the model to open an optional resource file and contains no executable command.

content.value_statement: SEO content often needs clear structure, natural keywords, and useful search snippets. This skill turns a topic brief into article drafts, titles, summaries, and FAQ ideas.
actual_capabilities: Creates full article drafts from a topic, target keywords, and word count.
Suggests three to five SEO title variations for a content brief.
Writes meta descriptions within a search-friendly character range.
Builds scannable outlines with H2 and H3 section ideas.
Adds key takeaways, FAQ ideas, and internal linking suggestions.
Uses natural keyword placement and semantic keyword variations.
limitations: Does not perform live keyword volume, ranking, or SERP research.
Does not verify factual claims unless source material is provided.
Does not publish content to a CMS or website.
Needs a clear topic, audience, and keyword brief for best results.

use_cases.title: Draft Blog Articles
use_cases.description: Create a structured SEO article with headings, keyword usage, and a clear conclusion.

use_cases.title: Prepare Content Briefs
use_cases.description: Turn a topic and target audience into an outline, title options, and writing requirements.

use_cases.title: Refresh Existing Pages
use_cases.description: Improve headings, meta descriptions, FAQ sections, and readability for an existing page.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Article
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a topic and keyword.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write an SEO article about [topic] for [audience]. Use [primary keyword] naturally and include a meta description.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Content Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an SEO outline for [topic]. Include search intent, H2 sections, H3 ideas, keyword placement, and FAQ questions.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize an Existing Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft for SEO quality, readability, keyword use, headings, meta description, and missing FAQ opportunities: [draft].

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Full Content Package
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with detailed strategy needs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete SEO content package for [topic], [audience], [primary keyword], and [secondary keywords]. Include article copy, titles, meta description, takeaways, links, and FAQs.

output_examples.input: Topic: choosing project management software. Keyword: project management software for startups.
output: A search-focused article outline with introduction, comparison sections, buying criteria, and conclusion.
Five title options that include the primary keyword naturally.
A concise meta description and FAQ section for common buyer questions.

output_examples.input: Draft page about local accounting services with weak headings and no meta description.
output: Rewritten headings that match local search intent.
A stronger meta description for service discovery.
FAQ ideas about pricing, consultations, tax deadlines, and business bookkeeping.

best_practices: Provide the target audience, search intent, primary keyword, secondary keywords, and desired word count.
Supply source material for facts, statistics, examples, and claims that need verification.
Review generated content for brand voice, accuracy, legal requirements, and publication standards.
anti_patterns: Do not request keyword stuffing or unnatural repetition.
Do not publish generated claims without checking facts and sources.
Do not use the skill as a replacement for live SEO research tools.

faq.question: Can this skill write a full SEO article?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft an article with headings, keyword placement, title ideas, meta description, takeaways, and FAQs.

faq.question: Does it research current search rankings?
faq.answer: No. It does not perform live SERP or keyword volume research unless another tool provides that data.

faq.question: What inputs work best?
faq.answer: Provide a topic, audience, primary keyword, secondary keywords, search intent, target word count, and source material.

faq.question: Can it improve existing content?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest better headings, meta descriptions, FAQ sections, readability changes, and keyword placement.

faq.question: Does it guarantee higher rankings?
faq.answer: No. It supports SEO writing quality, but rankings depend on competition, authority, links, technical SEO, and freshness.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
